title: Unit normalisation dereferences a missing default unit
symptom: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toLowerCase')
error_signature: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toLowerCase')
root_cause: normaliseUnit() drops the empty-string fallback, so a reading with no unit for a metric that has no default unit calls toLowerCase() on undefined.

title: Offline sweep dereferences lastSeen of seeded, never-seen devices
symptom: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'getTime')
error_signature: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'getTime')
root_cause: offlineDevices() no longer skips devices whose lastSeen is null (seeded from inventory but never reported) and forces the type with a non-null assertion, so the sweep dereferences null.

title: '+' wildcard compiled to match across topic levels
symptom: TelemetryValidationError: topic "devices/gw-1/children/node-7/telemetry" is not a device telemetry topic
error_signature: TelemetryValidationError: topic "devices/gw-1/children/node-7/telemetry" is not a device telemetry topic
root_cause: The '+' level is compiled to '(.*)' instead of '([^/]*)', so devices/+/telemetry also matches gateway child topics and the parent telemetry handler receives a topic the parser rejects.

title: $SYS guard rejects every filter containing a wildcard
symptom: UnroutedMessageError: broker delivered "$SYS/hub-broker/heartbeat" but no local subscription matches (subscribed: devices/+/telemetry, devices/+/children/+/telemetry, devices/+/status, $SYS/+/heartbeat)
error_signature: UnroutedMessageError: broker delivered "$SYS/hub-broker/heartbeat" but no local subscription matches (subscribed: devices/+/telemetry, devices/+/children/+/telemetry, devices/+/status, $SYS/+/heartbeat)
root_cause: The $-topic guard tests for any '+' or '#' anywhere in the filter instead of a wildcard in the first level, so '$SYS/+/heartbeat' never matches the broker heartbeat and dispatch finds no handler.

title: Client connection closed before in-flight handlers are drained
symptom: Error: mqtt client is not connected
error_signature: Error: mqtt client is not connected
root_cause: close() nulls the client and ends the connection before awaiting drain(), so a handler still running publishes its alert after the client is gone.

title: Registry seed load no longer awaited at startup
symptom: RegistryNotReadyError: device registry accessed before load() completed
error_signature: RegistryNotReadyError: device registry accessed before load() completed
root_cause: start() fires registry.load() without awaiting it, so subscriptions go live and the first message is handled before the registry is ready.

title: p95 index rounds past the end of short windows
symptom: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')
error_signature: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')
root_cause: The p95 index uses Math.round(0.95 * n) instead of Math.ceil(0.95 * n) - 1, which equals n (one past the last element) for windows of 10 readings or fewer.

title: Range validation made exclusive at both bounds
symptom: TelemetryValidationError: humidity value 100 is outside the allowed range [0, 100]
error_signature: TelemetryValidationError: humidity value 100 is outside the allowed range [0, 100]
root_cause: assertInRange() uses <= and >= instead of < and >, so values exactly on the documented inclusive bounds (e.g. humidity 100) are rejected.
